title: Search countertops for target objects before opening cabinets
description: Use this when looking for small household items like mugs, bowls, or utensils.
content: When searching for a small object such as a mug, check countertops first because they often hold commonly used items in plain view, whereas cabinets may contain unrelated objects and require extra opening steps.

description: Use this when a task requires cleaning an object before moving it to a destination.
content: After picking up the target object, go to a sinkbasin and use the clean action with the object and sinkbasin before transporting the object to its final location.

title: Search multiple locations before assuming an item is absent
description: Use when looking for multiple instances of the same object type and the first location does not contain them.
content: When searching for multiple identical objects, check several plausible surfaces or containers rather than stopping after one location. Objects of the same type are often distributed across different locations in the environment.

title: Handle failed pickup actions by re-examining the source location
description: Use when a take action fails or returns "Nothing happens" despite the object appearing in the observation.
content: If a pickup action fails, return to the source location and attempt the action again after verifying the object is still present. A failed action may be transient, and the object can often be successfully picked up on a subsequent attempt.

title: Open a container before placing objects inside it
description: Use when the target container is closed and you need to move objects into it.
content: Before moving an object into a drawer or similar container, navigate to it and open it if it is closed. Once the container is open, you can move items into it successfully.
